description: cinatra#2024 (S9 program acceptance) — closeout rows that this program does NOT re-test, only re-cites: evidence that already exists on real, merged artifacts, per the design's own re-cite convention ('honest verdict rows pointing at real artifacts, never a new suite'). Every artifact named here was independently confirmed to exist (read from the live repo tree or the live merged-PR record) before being cited — none of this is assumed from an issue's own prose.

verdicts.item: internal-pipeline-equivalence (S1 VERIFY: ewpa/create-post, ewpa/upload-image, ewpa/update-post-meta, ewpa/get-posts)

detail.summary: 3 of 4 VERIFY items PASS (ewpa/create-post draft-at-creation, ewpa/update-post-meta, ewpa/get-posts publish-filter+ordering); 1 disclosed FAIL (ewpa/upload-image — inputSchema is URL-only, no base64/MIME fields) with a named fallback (an upstream contribution to enable-abilities-for-mcp, never a cinatra ability rewrite) — this is the program's own accepted, disclosed carve-out, not a silent gap
detail.note: no new run performed; this row simply carries the already-committed capture's own provenance forward into S9's closing checklist

verdicts.item: blog-publish regression (3 of 4 legs re-pointed onto the generic invoker; the featured-image-upload carve-out stays on direct WordPress core REST, unchanged)

detail.whatItAsserts: draft creation -> ewpa/create-post, draft meta write -> ewpa/update-post-meta, latest-published read -> ewpa/get-posts all reach the governed invoker; the featured-image upload leg never reaches the invoker and stays on direct WordPress core REST — the suite asserts the both-paths-live seam never leaks either direction

localRun.environment: local (operator box), re-run fresh at this evidence capture's own commit

verdicts.item: pointer regression (wordpress_content_editor_run relay extraction — a pure refactor, no behavior change)

detail.note: a different repo from cinatra core — verified via the live merged-PR record (title, file list, merge commit), not re-run locally in this cinatra worktree. Extracts wordpress_content_editor_run's dispatch into its own relay module; the PR's own test files (updated, not newly added) cover the refactor. CI required checks passed at merge, per branch protection on that repo.

verdicts.item: webhook regression (settings-page webhook subscription URL repointed off the retired legacy route)

detail.note: a small, direct URL-construction edit (19 additions, 2 deletions), no dedicated regression test was added alongside it — recorded honestly rather than implying test coverage that does not exist. The change itself is verified to exist via the live merged-PR record; CI required checks passed at merge, per branch protection on that repo.

verdicts.item: multi-site / multi-server determinism (pin enforcement, serverId disambiguation, collision rejection)

detail.alreadyCaptured: cinatra#2018 (S3), closed — pre-dates S9, re-cited here rather than re-tested
detail.whatItAsserts: a wrong instanceId against a signed pin, and a foreign connectorKey pin (cross-connector), both reject as instance_pin_mismatch — at both the invoker layer and the site-tools-list layer
detail.checkedAgainstCinatra2255: cinatra#2255's own M1 governed-invoker scale-matrix test proves a DIFFERENT, complementary invariant — correct positive attribution of concurrent calls to their own pinned instance+server at scale — not pin-REJECTION. The two are not duplicates: this row is the negative/rejection half, #2255 is the positive/attribution-under-concurrency half.
detail.designSuggestedExtensionNotDoneHere: the design (§2 row 1b/§3) suggests optionally extending this suite with scale-smoke-plugin's server as an 'extra manual server route' — not done in this batch (the determinism guarantee this row proves — pin enforcement, serverId disambiguation, collision rejection — already holds regardless of which server names are involved); left as optional future work, not a gap in this row's PASS
